name: circuit-design-benchmarks
description: A collection of electronic circuit design testcases intended to evaluate automated design, synthesis, and verification systems. The benchmark measures a model or tool's ability to interpret circuit specifications, produce valid netlists or designs, and meet functional/optimization constraints. Tasks commonly include layout/netlist generation, correctness verification, and optimization of circuit metrics.
reputation: Niche dataset mainly used in circuit design and verification research; not broadly used in general LLM benchmarking.
